name: MedFact-Bench
description:
[!Note]
The inclusion of datasets does not imply endorsement or agreement to their content by the authors or their employers. The datasets were selected based on prior work in the field of claim verification.

To evaluate Med-V1, we curate MedFact-Bench, a benchmark comprising five biomedical verification datasets: SciFact, HealthVer, MedAESQA, PubMedQA-Fact (re-purposed PubMedQA), and BioASQ-Fact (re-purposed BioASQ). 
Across all datasets, each instance consists of a claim–source pair… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/ncbi/MedFact-Bench.
evaluation_method: accuracy / F1 (and evidence retrieval metrics where applicable)
reputation: Curated by NCBI from multiple biomedical fact-verification datasets; used in medical NLP and claim verification research with moderate adoption.
